title: Existing evaluation acyclicity for large constant coefficients
statement: For any scheme X:Scheme.{u}, commutative Λ:Type(u+1), and injective ModuleCat.{u+1} Λ-valued sheaf I on X_et, every positive right derived evaluation at every W in X.Etale of its underlying abelian sheaf is zero. No assumption Λ:Type u or abelian injectivity of forget(I) is made.

source.place: Tag 03FD, second paragraph via 03FC and 03F9; existing helper in ModuleAbelianDerivedDirectImageComparison

proof.text: Transport I through moduleSheaf_constantRing_equivalence; the underlying abelian sheaf is unchanged and the image is injective. Apply injective_module_sheaf_injective_presheaf.

For every etale covering and positive degree use injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift_max in coefficient universe u+1. Its boundary witness proves the SiteCech complex exact, hence zero homology. Transfer to the usual etale Cech complex.

Apply the etale Cech vanishing criterion with all objects and all covers, each refining itself. Transport the resulting zero right derived evaluation through the underlying-sheaf comparison. This is the already proved private helper reused through import all.

mathlib_searches.query: Exact functor derived Hom comparison is injective when source Hom comparisons are bijective on injectives and forgotten injectives are acyclic
A pulled back free abelian represented sheaf corepresents evaluation and underlying injective module sheaves are acyclic for its Hom functor
mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.H, cohomologyPresheafFunctor, GabrielPopescu.preservesInjectiveObjects; no matching scalar comparison.
InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and its apply/symm lemmas exist in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Ext.

No duplicate raw injectivity theorem. Found the free sections adjunction, ExtRightDerivedHom, the acyclic-resolution API, representedEquiv in RawRestrictedHomotopySectionsIso, and the proved evaluation-acyclicity helper in ModuleAbelianDerivedDirectImageComparison. The common-universe generic ringed-site lemma does not directly fit coefficients in u+1.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleAbelianForget_injective_evaluation_acyclic
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [Injective G]
    (W : X.Etale) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
      (evaluation X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (Opposite.op W)).rightDerived
        (n + 1)).obj ((moduleAbelianForget Λ X).obj G))
lean.note: Canonical upstream declaration; the forwarding Sheaf module is retired. The private evaluation helper is accessed directly with import all. No statement, proof dependency or unit route changes.
